reading.action: Floor 2 (cleared): test whether crafting is possible — gather sac of swarm-ichor + spare iron bar + river-stone; reach into the sac's essence and, instead of drawing it into himself, pull it OUT of the sac and push it INTO the spare iron bar.
reading.dcRationale: hard novel technique: base essence-manipulation ~14 + opposite-element (cold swarm essence vs his Ember fluency) + essence TRANSFER into an object (unproven mode, harder than self-draw) = DC 19. INTELLECT primary (novel-technique discovery, his peak/analyst edge). No affinity bias — Ember Manipulation is the WRONG element; the affinity gave him the concept that essence has a graspable shape, not fluency with cold.
reading.result: STRONG SUCCESS (margin 17). CRAFTING CONFIRMED POSSIBLE here. (1) NEW SKILL emerged by deed: Essence Infusion (Novice, seeded 4) — extract an external essence from its source and bind it into a separate object; distinct from Ember Channel (own Ember, transient) — element-neutral motor technique, external source, persistent binding. (2) ITEM IMBUED: spare iron bar -> 'Iron bar (cold-bitten)' — minor chill/caustic rider on strike, but binding is CRUDE/UNSTABLE (Novice): bleeds off with use, not permanent; Alan can feel it won't last. (3) MATERIAL CONSUMED: sac of swarm-ichor essence spent into the iron -> sac removed (inert). (4) COST: Focus 110 -> 80 (-30, the cold essence drained the well while held in transit); NO HP backlash (clean success). (5) NO affinity change — Ember counter stays 1 (wrong element); NO cold affinity acquired (externalized, not absorbed) -> sidesteps the pending per-point schedule. River-stone untouched (gathered, not acted on — no assumed intent). NO Tower reset.
